# Kaytee and Jane Lynch Give Birding a Close-Up With New Smart Bird Feeders


November 03, 2026 9:03am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_d7ea2b4b8763a0a8ef168b6e2cbd6ae4/central/news/2026-11-03_Kaytee_and_Jane_Lynch_Give_Birding_a_Close_Up_493.pdf)


*Featuring AI-powered bird identification, 2K cameras and no subscription required, the new feeding kits bring backyard entertainment and discovery to bird lovers everywhere.*


FRANKLIN, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- You never know who's stopping by your backyard when you're not looking. Now, thanks to[Kaytee®](http://www.kaytee.com/) , a trusted leader in pet bird and wild bird nutrition, you don't have to miss a moment. Today, Kaytee, part of the Central Garden & Pet portfolio, announced the launch of its new[Smart Bird Feeding Seed & Suet Kit and Smart Bird Feeding Hummingbird Kit](https://www.kaytee.com/all-products/wild-bird/smart-bird-feeders) , two innovative products designed to bring bird lovers closer to nature through cutting-edge technology, expert guidance and effortless bird identification.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261103803060/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261103803060/en/)


Kaytee turns backyard birding into must-watch entertainment with new Smart Bird Feeder Kits. Featuring the Kaytee Smart Bird Feeder Seed & Suet Kit (left) and Smart Humming Bird Feeder & Nectar Kit (right), both complete kits combine 2K cameras, AI-powered bird identification and trusted Kaytee bird nutrition to help bird lovers attract, watch and discover more, with no subscription required.


Whether it's a colorful hummingbird making a quick appearance or an unexpected visitor stopping by for a snack, Kaytee's new Smart Feeders take the guesswork - and the fear of missing out - out of backyard birding. Equipped with built-in 2K cameras and AI-powered identification technology designed to recognize more than 11,000 bird species through the companion app, the feeders allow birders to watch, identify and capture their feathered visitors in real time or revisit the action whenever they choose.


Kaytee has partnered with Emmy Award-winning actress and comedian Jane Lynch and birding expert and advocate Christian Cooper to celebrate the launch. Together, they help inspire a new generation of backyard bird enthusiasts to discover the surprising world of birds right outside their doors.


"There's an entire world of entertainment happening in your backyard, and most of us have no idea what we're missing," said Jane Lynch. "With Kaytee's new Smart Bird Feeder, you get a front-row seat to all the action, even when you're not around to see it. It's like having your own little reality show starring the neighborhood birds, and trust me, they've got plenty of personality."


Designed for birders of all experience levels, Kaytee’s new Smart Bird Feeding Kits pair smart technology with trusted bird nutrition, providing everything needed to attract and observe backyard birds right out of the box.


The collection includes:


- [Kaytee Smart Bird Feeding Seed & Suet Kit](https://www.kaytee.com/all-products/wild-bird/smart-seed-suet-kit) **(MSRP $249):** Features a built-in 2K camera, AI-powered bird identification and premium Kaytee seed and suet. Dual solar panels, a long-lasting battery and a large-capacity, easy-to-clean feeder let users capture live views, photos and videos—even while away.
- [Kaytee Smart Bird Feeding Hummingbird Kit](https://www.kaytee.com/all-products/wild-bird/smart-hummingbird-kit) **(MSRP $199):** Offers an up-close view of hummingbirds with a built-in 2K camera and AI-powered bird identification. Includes ready-to-use nectar, an easy-fill design, ant protection, dual solar panels and a long-lasting battery.


Both kits include all smart features with no subscription required, plus a 32GB SD card for local photo and video storage and complimentary three-day rolling cloud storage included, while longer cloud retention requires a paid monthly or annual plan.


The companion Kaytee Smart Bird Feeder app identifies more than 11,000 bird species and lets users share backyard moments. The Kaytee Birder Hub provides expert advice, seasonal feeding tips and educational resources for year-round discovery.


Beyond the feeders themselves, Kaytee is helping bird enthusiasts turn everyday sightings into opportunities for discovery and education. The companion Kaytee Smart Bird Feeder app helps users identify more than 11,000 bird species and share memorable backyard moments, while the[Kaytee Birder Hub](https://www.kaytee.com/birderhub) offers expert advice, seasonal feeding tips and educational resources to help birders make the most of their hobby year-round.


“Birding has always been about curiosity, discovery and connecting with the natural world around us,” said Christian Cooper. “What excites me about Kaytee's new Smart Bird Feeder is its ability to make those experiences more accessible to everyone. Whether you're identifying a species for the first time or spotting a familiar visitor, every bird offers an opportunity to learn something new and deepen your appreciation for nature.”


“At Kaytee, we're always looking for new ways to bring more value and excitement to the birding experience,” said Manny Orejuela, Senior Vice President of Marketing for Kaytee. “By combining our decades of expertise in bird nutrition with innovative technology, we're giving consumers a new way to enjoy their backyards and making it easier than ever to capture the moments they might otherwise miss.”


The new[Kaytee Smart Bird Feeding Seed & Suet Kit](https://www.amazon.com/Kaytee-Smart-Feeder-Pounds-Capacity/dp/B0HN5ZX3FM?ref_=ast_sto_dp) **(MSRP $249)** and[Smart Bird Feeding Hummingbird Kit](https://www.amazon.com/Kaytee-Hummingbird-Feeder-Nectar-Capacity/dp/B0HN5T9F1J?ref_=ast_sto_dp) **(MSRP $199)** are available for purchase on[Amazo](https://www.amazon.com/stores/page/8233FE54-0D0A-496D-AA7C-AFD32FF7B8A3?ingress=2&lp_context_asin=B000Q37F1S&lp_context_query=kaytee%20food&visitId=d0f3b72c-c0d3-4f2f-8c4c-95cada7491e9&store_ref=bl_ast_dp_brandlogo_sto&ref_=ast_bln)[n](https://www.amazon.com/stores/page/8233FE54-0D0A-496D-AA7C-AFD32FF7B8A3?ingress=2&lp_context_asin=B000Q37F1S&lp_context_query=kaytee%20food&visitId=d0f3b72c-c0d3-4f2f-8c4c-95cada7491e9&store_ref=bl_ast_dp_brandlogo_sto&ref_=ast_bln) . To learn more about the collection, explore seasonal birding resources and discover the wildlife visiting your backyard,[visit our website](https://www.kaytee.com/all-products/wild-bird/smart-bird-feeders) .


**About Kaytee**


[Kaytee®](http://www.kaytee.com/) is a leading brand in small-animal and bird care, helping pet parents nurture healthy, happy companions for more than 150 years. From food, hay and treats to bedding, habitats, toys, and accessories, Kaytee designs products to support well-being, enrichment, and the bond between people and their pets—whether that’s hamsters, rabbits, guinea pigs, parakeets, cockatiels, parrots, or the wild birds in your backyard. Backed by in-house nutrition and animal-care expertise, Kaytee also offers easy, research-based care guides and how-tos to help pets thrive at every life stage. Learn more at[www.kaytee.com](http://www.kaytee.com/) . Kaytee is part of the Central Garden & Pet (NASDAQ: CENT, CENTA) portfolio.
